title: SM-16.12 - Alternatives for external users after the EUSurvey transition
intent: This article answers: SM-16.12 - Alternatives for external users after the EUSurvey transition
short_answer: External users can work with an EU institution, use another survey platform, or deploy their own EUSurvey instance under the European Union Public Licence.
important_conditions: An EU official can create the survey and grant Form Manager privileges.
External users may choose another commercial or open-source survey platform that meets their requirements.
Organizations can deploy their own EUSurvey instance from the open-source code and host it on their infrastructure.
